# Memberspot

Memberspot is an online course and video-hosting platform designed to facilitate knowledge management and community engagement for businesses.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/memberspot/.

## Actions

- **Create Login Token** (read-only): Generate a one-hour login token for a user.
- **Delete Users**: Delete one or more users from the platform.
- **Find user by email** (read-only): Retrieve a user's details by their email address.
- **List all offers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all offers.
- **List custom user properties** (read-only): List all defined custom user properties.
- **List Users** (read-only): List all users.
- **Set order state**: Set the state of an order-based offer for a user.
- **Set user offer state**: Revoke or set the state of a specific offer for a user.
